mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, w.created_at, w.updated_at FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'active' ORDER BY w.id
SELECT w.id, w.name, w.slug, wm.role FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.workspace_id = w.id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND wm.status = 'active' ORDER BY w.name, w.id

mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'active' )

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.timezone, u.last_login_at, u.profile_picture_url, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.status = 'active' ORDER BY u.display_name, u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.profile_picture_url AS profilePictureUrl, COALESCE(wr.name, wm.role) AS role, wm.role_id AS roleId, wm.status AS status FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN workspace_role wr ON wr.id = wm.role_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(wm.role, 'owner', 'admin', 'member'), u.display_name, u.id

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name AS displayName, u.email, u.profile_picture_url AS profilePictureUrl, COALESCE(wr.name, wm.role) AS role, wm.role_id AS roleId, wm.status AS status FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN workspace_role wr ON wr.id = wm.role_id WHERE wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND wm.user_id = #{userId}
